sections.heading: Game Incident
paragraphs: According to Bleacher Report, Caitlin Clark faces a suspension for her 8th technical foul after contact with a referee during a game between the Fever and the Sky.

sections.heading: Suspension Details
paragraphs: The New York Times reports that Clark earns a 1-game suspension after her 8th technical foul. USA Today also notes that she picked up her eighth technical of the season against the Sky and faces a suspension.
